judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements per-turn usage accumulation across rounds, handles missing per-round usage without NaN or undefined regressions, updates the CHANGELOG, and satisfies all acceptance criteria. To make the hook signature unambiguous, the candidate introduces a `TurnUsageMetadata` type alias whereas the reference renames the parameter to `totalUsage: UsageMetadata` and keeps `accumulateUsage` private to `chatOrchestrator.ts`. However, the candidate leaves the variable named `lastUsage` inside `chatOrchestrator.ts`, fails to update the `OrchestratorHooks` doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` to match the new `TurnUsageMetadata` signature, and places the updated `afterModelResponse` spec bullet under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` while flipping the spec status from Shipped to In Progress. It also unnecessarily extracts `scriptedProvider` into a separate test support file requiring a `jest.config.js` coverage exclusion.
